component: Thunderbird S/MIME certificate override prompt localization

quotes.text: Would you like to use it anyway? Certificate verification failed with the following error: { $errorMsg } (Error Code: { $errorCodeStr })

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up replaces a failure message plus a separately concatenated override question with one complete Fluent message per error branch. The NSS branch supplies errorMsg and errorCodeStr; the other branch supplies errorCode. The selection consumer passes the formatted result directly to the confirmation prompt. Current v2 messages later change line breaks and sentence order; that is a separate phase. No locale or dialog execution was performed.
title: The S/MIME override prompt is formatted as one localized message
